title: Detection, coverage and percolation in dynamic Boolean models with random radii based on $α$-stable processes
summary: We consider a dynamic network in continuum time and space in which nodes, with initial locations given by a Poisson point process, move according to i.i.d. isotropic $α$-stable processes. Each node is additionally equipped with an i.i.d. detection radius.
